# Bodyguiding

> Bodyguiding is an integrative somatic physiotherapy approach developed by Kamila Moravcová, MSc. It supports individuals in developing a more direct, embodied relationship with their own body — using touch, movement, and mindful awareness to encourage natural, self-directed change.

Kamila Moravcová holds a Master's degree in Physiotherapy from Charles University in Prague and has been in clinical practice since 2008. Her approach is rooted in biotensegrity, fascia research, integral anatomy, and the functional work of Clara Lewitová. She works with individuals, professionals, and groups in both Czech and English. All sessions take place online.

- [About Kamila Moravcová](https://www.bodyguiding.com/en/about): Background, clinical training, methodology influences, and professional philosophy.
- [Work with Me](https://www.bodyguiding.com/en/services): Individual sessions, intensive programmes, co-vision for professionals, and group workshops — with full pricing and booking information.
- [Events & Workshops](https://www.bodyguiding.com/en/events): Upcoming Curious Spaces group workshops and events.
- [Contact](https://www.bodyguiding.com/en/contact): Booking a free introductory call and general enquiries.

## Services

### Bodyguiding — Individual Session
- **Price:** €200
- **Duration:** 90 minutes (allow up to 2 hours)
- **Format:** Online
- **For:** Anyone coming with pain, a specific question, or curiosity about their body. No fixed commitment — some clients find clarity in one session; others choose to continue.
- **Includes:** A short intake questionnaire before the first session to help focus the work.

### Bodyguiding Intensive
- **Price:** €1,800–€3,000 (depending on structure and level of support)
- **Duration:** 3-month process with regular sessions and between-session support
- **Format:** Online
- **For:** Those ready for sustained, integrative work over time. Includes tailored support materials — short videos, movement explorations, and insights into living anatomy and physiology relevant to the individual's process.
- **How to start:** Free introductory call to define the structure and investment.

### Co-Vision — Individual Session
- **Price:** €160
- **Duration:** 75 minutes (allow up to 90 minutes)
- **Format:** Online
- **For:** Physiotherapists, movement teachers, bodyworkers, and related professionals seeking a fresh perspective on a case, clinical reasoning, or their way of working. One-time or ongoing.
- **Includes:** Brief topic outline requested before the session. Individual workshop bookings available from March 2027; ongoing sessions available now.

### Curious Spaces — Workshops
- **Format:** Small group workshops, in-person or online
- **Topics:** Living body and biotensegrity, women's health, relationship to oneself
- **For:** Professionals and individuals who want embodied, experiential learning in a group setting. Custom workshops available on request.
- **Availability:** Individual workshops available again from November 2026. Early booking recommended.

### Free Introductory Call
- **Price:** Free
- **Purpose:** A first conversation to explore whether working together is a good fit, and to define the structure for an intensive if relevant.
- [Book here](https://www.bodyguiding.com/en/contact)

## About the Practitioner

- **Name:** Kamila Moravcová
- **Credentials:** MSc Physiotherapy, Charles University Prague
- **Clinical practice since:** 2008
- **Specialisations:** Somatic awareness, biotensegrity, fascia, women's health, interdisciplinary psychosomatic work
- **Key influences:** Clara Lewitová (functional approach), fascia and integral anatomy research, biotensegrity (central to practice since 2020), psychotherapy with horses (Jana Zajícová)
- **Languages:** Czech, English
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/kamila_bgm/
